RfcArchiveAuditV1.bounds: changed_rfc_count and excluded_prearchived_count are scalar exact totals. Complete changed RFC identities remain row-wise authority in rfc_archive_operation_members/rfc_archive_events. The owning audit has exactly one result ref, the rfc_archive_operation; no per-member audit ref collection is permitted.
rules: ticket.rfc.archived changed_rfc_count equals committed operation membership count and each changed RFC has exactly one archived event for the command
ticket.rfc.archive_restored changed_rfc_count equals exact restored-event count for that command; members owned by later archive history are skipped
scope_fingerprint is the exact SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 reviewed fingerprint and is never replaced by paged member data
both archive actions have exactly one audit_event_results row of type rfc_archive_operation pointing to rfc_archive_operation_id
ticket.rfc.terminal_cascade_refreshed targets prior_proposal_id and its sole proposal result ref is replacement_proposal_id
prior_proposal_revision is the reviewed pending base revision; resulting_prior_proposal_revision is exactly prior+1; replacement_proposal_revision is 1
terminal_epoch_id is identical across prior and replacement proposals

RfcTerminalCascadeAuditV1.bounds: reviewed_preview_fingerprint binds complete reviewed provider count/fingerprint summaries. Both apply-result objects are fixed-shape RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 correlation summaries only; exact provider result/history/audit identities remain provider-owned and no unbounded result-ref array is copied.
rules: ticket.rfc.terminal_cascade_executed uses state_transition literal pending_to_executed and proposal_revision is resulting executed proposal revision
reviewed_preview_fingerprint equals exact execution_review.preview_fingerprint accepted after writer-time revalidation
task_objective_apply_result.domain is TASKS_OBJECTIVES and communication_apply_result.domain is COMMUNICATIONS
participant counts are nonnegative and result_fingerprint values lowercase sha256
LLD-03 execution audit has exactly one result ref: executed rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal
forbidden: copied provider impact rows or descriptions
deleted dependent history because eligibility requires none
